first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A man with side-parted brown hair and a thin mustache, wearing a dark purple jacket with piping, a white shirt, and a black bow tie, and holding a note and pen; light gray trousers are visible in the final segment.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: A young man wearing a dark purple stand-collar uniform and a purple cylindrical hat with two lines of gold lettering on the front, walking alongside Person A.

entities.name: red patterned carpet
entities.identification: The red-backed carpets in the lobby passage and along its sides, with light-colored borders and repeating patterns.

entities.name: large potted palm
entities.identification: The collection of large palms with long, dark green, feather-like leaves in the lobby, without forcing individual plants to be matched across shots.

entities.name: Person F
entities.identification: An adult man wearing a fitted dark purple stand-collar uniform and a purple hat with a chin strap, holding one of the two dark long-handled objects in each hand.

entities.name: Person G
entities.identification: A woman wearing a long beige coat, black bottoms, and a black brimmed hat, holding Animal A against the front of the chest and carrying a black handbag.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The small black shaggy dog held against the front of Person G's chest, with its lower portion mutually occluded by the arms and handbag.

entities.name: Person H
entities.identification: An adult man behind and to the image-right of Person F, wearing a long white garment and a white hat.

entities.name: cream-pink wall and arched niche
entities.identification: The light warm-pink lobby wall, with rectangular sections, arched areas, and light-colored decorative borders.

entities.name: golden-brown stone-faced column
entities.identification: A tall golden-brown column with an irregularly textured surface, vertical borders, and a dark base.

entities.name: warm-white globe lights and wall lights
entities.identification: The collection of hanging globe lights, small bulbs along the arch edges, and wall-mounted lights in the lobby.

entities.name: wood-framed upholstered chair in the lobby
entities.identification: The collection of wood-framed seats with armrests and cushions in the lounge area; the frames range from brown to dark, and the cushions include light-colored and dark brown ones.

entities.name: small round table in the lobby
entities.identification: The collection of small tables in the lounge area with round brown tabletops and dark slender supports.

entities.name: guests and staff in the background
entities.identification: The collection of other seated and standing people in the lounge area and in the distance along the passage, excluding Person A, Person B, Person F, Person G, and Person H.

entities.name: metallic round flowerpot
entities.identification: A brown-and-gold, nearly cylindrical planter with a ring-shaped rim and decorations on the planter wall.

entities.name: glossy black handbag
entities.identification: The glossy black, nearly rectangular bag body in front of Person G and below Animal A, with part of its upper edge occluded.

entities.name: staircase
entities.identification: The partially visible ascending staircase at the left rear in the final segment, with a light-colored railing and a diagonal side visible.

entities.name: light-colored ceiling
entities.identification: The light-colored ceiling above the lobby in the middle segment, with rectilinear sections and beam-like decorative edges.

entities.name: geometric-patterned floor
entities.identification: The floor exposed beyond the red carpet, with dark repeating patterns on a light-colored ground.

entities.name: cups and saucers on the tabletop
entities.identification: The collection of small cups, shallow saucers, and small reflective vessels on the round tables.

entities.name: two dark long-handled objects
entities.identification: The dark elongated props held separately in Person F's two hands; one has a wider, curved lower end, while the other has a thinner, longer lower end.
